name: moe_register_aliasing
description: Alias _v_G/_v_U weight VGPR windows across GEMM phases and reuse MFMA A-operand range as MAX-reduction scratch to stay under VGPR budget
preconditions: VGPR pressure near the occupancy-2 boundary (~256)
hand-written ISA or register-pinned CK path
steps: Use one _v_G window that points at G during GEMM0 and at U during GEMM1 -- never live simultaneously
Complete the Z dequant and its last read of _v_G before GEMM1 issues its first U load into the same window
After GEMM1 dequant, reuse the A-operand fragment window as _v_Max scratch (2 dwords per thread) and then as the _v_GMAX 32-entry gather buffer
Keep _v_Z and _v_GM1 fp32 accumulators live across activation and act(Z)*GM1 so no spill is needed
Document the alias map in a comment block; a prologue that reads a window assuming the prior phase's content is a correctness bug
expected_impact: keeps the fused MoE kernel under the 256-VGPR occupancy boundary without spills
